ns2:section.sectionText: 2 or 4 GR hours; be sure to enroll in your desired credit hours. Meets in Room 242 LISB. Open to graduate students campus-wide. See section description at http://www.lis.illinois.edu/academics/courses/catalog . Prerequisites: Basic working knowledge of predicate logic required; some familiarity with modal notions and semantic technologies recommended. Undergraduates (juniors or seniors) should have relevant background in linguistics, philosophy, or computer science, and need permission of instructor to enroll (renear@illinois.edu).
